answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 30947 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: If my husband's earning is low and we are "unable" to give Zakah or pay rent regularly or give Sadaqah whole heartedly, can I operate a business from home and say to him that we will share the earnings. Question: If my husband's earning is low and we are "unable" to give Zakah or pay rent regularly or give Sadaqah whole heartedly, can I operate a business from home and say to him that we will share the earnings. Is this right? Answer ID: 30947 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 476/365=L=1432) You can start a business at home. It is not prohibited for women to operate business if they maintain Shariah limits. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
